issues.legal_issue: The court fee for a non-executant seeking a declaration that transfer deeds do not bind him or his share, together with consequential possession, is determined under the rules for declaratory suits with consequential relief rather than as a suit to cancel the deeds.
material_facts: The plaintiff had not executed the sale deeds at issue.
The plaint sought a declaration that the deeds did not bind the co-parcenary and sought joint possession; it did not seek cancellation of the deeds.
The lower courts treated the prayers as seeking cancellation and required court fees based on the consideration stated in the deeds.
issues.conclusion: The court fee was to be calculated under section 7(iv)(c) read with section 7(v), with reference to the plaint averments, rather than on the sale consideration stated in the deeds.
issues.legal_principle: Under the Court-fees Act, 1870 as amended in Punjab, an executant seeking to avoid a deed must seek its cancellation and pay ad valorem court fee on the consideration stated in it. A non-executant seeking a declaration that a deed is invalid or not binding does not seek cancellation. If that non-executant is in possession and seeks only a declaration, the fixed fee under Entry 17(iii) of the Second Schedule applies; if not in possession and seeking consequential possession, section 7(iv)(c) applies, subject to its second proviso requiring valuation not below the value calculated under section 7(v). No earlier cases are relied on in the judgment.

rule.if: suit_court_fee_dispute and plaintiff_is_non_executant and seeks_declaration_deed_not_binding and seeks_consequential_possession and not seeks_cancellation

predicates.suit_court_fee_dispute: The proceeding is a suit in which the court fee payable for the reliefs sought is disputed.
predicates.plaintiff_is_non_executant: The plaintiff did not execute the transfer deed whose effect is challenged.
predicates.seeks_declaration_deed_not_binding: The plaintiff seeks a declaration that the deed is invalid or does not bind the plaintiff or the plaintiff’s share.
predicates.seeks_consequential_possession: The plaintiff seeks possession as consequential relief to the declaration.
predicates.seeks_cancellation: The plaintiff asks the court to cancel the deed.
predicates.court_fee_assessed_under_declaratory_con: The court fee is assessed under the method applicable to a declaratory decree with consequential relief, subject to the applicable property-valuation rules.

issues.definition: When a non-executant in a court-fee dispute seeks a declaration that a deed is not binding and consequential possession, without seeking cancellation, the court fee is assessed under the declaratory consequential-relief method.
